name: Developerlook
details: Modern agency and company website built with Next.js, Strapi-powered content management, and smooth animated storytelling for services, projects, and case studies.
features: CMS-driven pages powered by Strapi for services, projects, blogs, and company content.
Localization support for managing content in multiple languages.
Modern animated UI built with GSAP and Framer Motion for section transitions and micro-interactions.
Lenis-based smooth scrolling and scroll-triggered animations.
Dynamic routes for projects, services, and blog posts with SEO-friendly URLs.
Blog and project archive pages with search and pagination.
Contact form with email notifications on new submissions.
Next.js Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) for fast, cache-friendly page delivery.
Highly optimized, responsive layout with strong performance across devices.

name: Syntech
details: Next.js-based agency site for a technology company with Strapi-managed content, smooth animations, and fast, SEO-friendly marketing pages.
features: Strapi CMS managing services, projects, blogs, and site-wide content.
Localization support for serving content to multiple regions and languages.
GSAP and Framer Motion animations for hero sections, content reveals, and interaction states.
Lenis smooth scrolling for a fluid browsing experience.
Dynamic service, project, and blog detail pages generated from CMS content.
Blog and project archive pages with search and pagination.
Contact form with email delivery on new inquiries.
Next.js ISR for fast builds and up-to-date content without full redeploys.
Responsive, performance-optimized layout across desktop and mobile.

name: Elevate
details: High-end agency / product site built with Next.js, Strapi, and advanced Three.js scenes combined with modern motion design.
features: Strapi-driven content for services, projects, blogs, and marketing pages.
Localization and region-aware content for different audiences.
Three.js powered hero/visual sections combined with GSAP and Framer Motion animations.
Lenis smooth scroll with scroll-triggered animations and parallax effects.
Dynamic routes for project case studies, services, and blog posts.
Archive pages for blogs and projects with search and pagination.
Contact form with email notifications for new leads.
Next.js ISR for ultra-fast, always-fresh content delivery.
Highly responsive, animation-rich experience tuned for performance.

name: Staffic.io
details: Time-tracking and productivity platform for teams with real-time tracking, AI-powered insights, and advanced reporting.
features: Real-time activity tracking and monitoring.
Real-time notifications where users can take action directly from notifications.
App and URL tracking for measuring focused work time.
Team management with roles, permissions, and member overviews.
AI-based productivity insights and suggestions.
Task and project management system integrated with time tracking.
Automated invoicing and reporting for clients and internal teams.
Advanced analytics dashboard for utilization, productivity, and billing.

name: Regulatory Jobs
details: Scalable regulatory job platform with AI-powered search, multi-role dashboards, and real-time communication for candidates, employers, and admins.
features: OpenAI-integrated AI agent for candidates and employers to ask about jobs or candidates.
Three roles—Candidate, Employer, and Admin—each with a dedicated login experience.
Real-time messaging and notifications where users can act directly from notifications.
Candidate dashboard for tracking application progress and saved jobs.
Admin panel with full-system analytics powered by Redis caching.
Admin blog management system for publishing and managing content.
Advanced job searching and filtering across multiple dimensions.
Employer dashboard with custom form builder for each job posting.

name: Lateral Hub
details: Premier legal job board and content platform connecting lateral attorney candidates with top-tier law firms.
features: Advanced job search with filters for location, practice area, and job level.
Infinite scrolling job listings with rich employer and role details.
Landing experience tailored for lateral attorney candidates and top-tier law firms.
Structured SEO metadata and schema for improved discoverability.
Newsletter and job alert flows to keep candidates informed.
Post-clerkship and interview preparation resources for candidates.

name: Fusion Kitchen
details: Frontend-focused restaurant and food experience built as a React SPA with rich motion and scrolling interactions.
features: React single-page application built with Vite and React Router.
Scroll and motion animations using AOS, React Spring, and Lottie.
Responsive, modern UI styled with Tailwind CSS.
Interactive components including marquee sections, typed text, and Swiper carousel.

name: Language Guard
details: This is a Foreign language learning website based on MERN Stack development. On this website, I have implemented 3 role-based user interfaces and functionalities. The roles are student, instructor, and admin. Please visit the project repository to know further about this project.
features: Dark-light toggle theme.
Authentication system with firebase.
Students can easily enroll in classes, book and manage their reservations, give feedback, delete bookings, and conveniently pay for their courses.
Instructors have the ability to add new classes, to monitor his added classes.
Administrators can efficiently manage classes, users, and assign instructor and admin roles, approved / denied classes.
Admins can give feedback to instructors about their classes.
Student can send message in the contact us section
